title: Perceptions of voluntary horizontal confidential food safety data sharing: An exploratory interview study with food industry leadership
Policy Options to Achieve US Sustainable Aviation Fuel Targets
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Decarbonizing aviation in the short term will likely entail replacing large quantities of petroleum jet fuel with sustainable aviation fuels (SAFs), which are predominantly biofuels. In the United States, biofuels are currently used as substitutes for gasoline and diesel in road transportation and are supported by a complex set of federal and state policies including the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), state low carbon fuel standards, and state and federal tax credits. Policies promoting SAF therefore interact with surface transport biofuel policies. In this paper, we use a new detailed partial equilibrium model of road and air transportation fuel markets to compare various policy options designed to achieve a target of 3 billion gallons of SAF by 2030.Our results suggest that the target is attainable with current technology but not with current policy. Several potential federal policies, including modifications to the existing RFS, a federal SAF tax credit, or a clean aviation standard could meet the 3 billion gallon target with similar emissions reductions and costs but different incidence. The lowest cost policy we study entails replacing all current biofuels policies with a modest carbon tax on fossil transportation fuels paired with a SAF tax credit.
abstract_zh: 短期内实现航空业脱碳，很可能需要以可持续航空燃料（SAF）大量替代石油基航空煤油，而SAF主要为生物燃料。在美国，生物燃料目前用作道路运输中汽油和柴油的替代品，并受到一整套复杂的联邦和州政策支持，包括《可再生燃料标准》（Renewable Fuel Standard，RFS）、各州低碳燃料标准，以及州和联邦层面的税收抵免。因此，促进SAF的政策与地面交通生物燃料政策相互关联。本文使用一个新的、细致的道路与航空运输燃料市场局部均衡模型，比较旨在于2030年前实现30亿加仑SAF目标的各类政策方案。结果表明，该目标在现有技术条件下可以实现，但在现行政策下无法实现。若干潜在的联邦政策，包括修订现行RFS、联邦SAF税收抵免或清洁航空标准，均可在实现30亿加仑目标的同时带来相近的减排效果和成本，但其税负归宿（incidence）有所不同。我们研究的成本最低的政策，是用适度的化石运输燃料碳税取代全部现行生物燃料政策，并辅以SAF税收抵免。

title: Effects of the Proposed New California SAF Tax Credit
venue: Energy Institute at Haas Working Paper

title: Agriculture's Nitrogen Legacy
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Nitrogen pollution of waterways is a large global problem, particularly in regions with intensive cropland agriculture, such as the Mississippi River Basin. Unlike prior studies based on agronomic and hydrologic (ag-hydro) models, we collect detailed data from water quality monitors and employ panel data econometric methods to estimate the relationship between cropland and nitrogen pollution. We find an increase in nitrogen load in nearby downstream waterways associated with an additional corn acre upstream that is substantially smaller than the field-to-river adjusted loss per cropland acre based on ag-hydro models. Our findings are consistent with those of recent research documenting the accumulation of large amounts of nitrogen in subsurface soil and groundwater over several decades; this is surplus nitrogen that was applied to fields but has yet to appear in waterways. In the presence of large amounts of legacy nitrogen, land retirement may not be cost effective, fluvial wetlands, which remove both legacy and new nitrogen, can be cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 水体氮污染是一个全球性的重大问题，在农田密集分布的地区尤为严重，例如密西西比河流域。与以往基于农学与水文（ag-hydro）模型的研究不同，我们收集了水质监测站的详细数据，并采用面板数据计量方法，估计耕地与氮污染之间的关系。我们发现，上游每增加一英亩玉米种植面积，邻近下游水体的氮负荷随之增加，但增幅显著小于基于农学水文模型推算的每英亩耕地从田间到河流的调整后损失。我们的发现与近期研究一致，后者记录了数十年间大量氮素在地下土壤和地下水中的积累；这些过剩氮素曾施入田间，但尚未进入水体。在存在大量遗留氮（legacy nitrogen）的情况下，退耕可能并不具有成本效益，而能够同时去除遗留氮和新增氮的河流湿地则可能具有成本效益。

title: Biofuels: Past, Present, and Future
Modeling Uncertainty in Climate Policy: An Application to the US IRA
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In recent years the analysis of US climate policy on the electricity sector has predominantly deployed electricity planning or capacity expansion models that use deterministic or equilibrium optimization methods. While uncertainty in key input assumptions is considered, it is usually restricted to scenario analysis. In this study we combine time-series econometric forecasting methods with an equilibrium electricity system-expansion model. The goal is to produce statistically rigorous distributions of outcomes, rather than rely upon individually selected scenarios. We apply these techniques to the case of the US Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) in the context of the western US electricity grid. The most significant power sector financial incentives are tax credits applied to eligible zero-carbon and storage resources. Our results indicate that the impact of the IRA, in terms of additional investment in low-carbon resources, depends heavily on the realization of key exogenous variables. However, the net effect of the IRA is to sharply narrow the range of future carbon emissions, largely by eliminating states of the world where investment in natural gas resources would otherwise be optimal. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国对电力部门气候政策的分析主要采用确定性或均衡优化方法的电力规划或装机容量扩张模型。虽然这些分析考虑了关键输入假设中的不确定性，但通常仅限于情景分析。本研究将时间序列计量预测方法与均衡电力系统扩张模型相结合。其目标是得出具有统计严谨性的结果分布，而非依赖人为挑选的若干情景。我们将这些方法应用于美国《通胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act，IRA）在美国西部电网背景下的情形。电力部门最重要的财政激励是对符合条件的零碳资源和储能资源给予的税收抵免。结果表明，就低碳资源的额外投资而言，《通胀削减法案》的影响在很大程度上取决于关键外生变量的实现情况。然而，该法案的净效应是大幅收窄未来碳排放的范围，主要方式是排除那些在无该法案时天然气投资将是最优的世界状态。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家居民，可免费从 www.nber.org 下载本文。

title: The Economic and Policy Challenges of Climate-Smart Agriculture
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Climate-smart agriculture promises to mitigate climate change by sequestering carbon in soils on working lands. However, this promise faces substantial policy challenges due to ecological variation, costly measurement, and uncertainty. We summarize the latest scientific literature on carbon sequestration in agricultural soils, and we describe the current policy environment. With that background, we present an economic framework for policy analysis. We conclude by emphasizing (a) the need for better measurement and for policy that is robust to poor measurement, and (b) the importance of improving agricultural productivity to avoid future carbon losses from expanded agricultural land use.
abstract_zh: 气候智能型农业有望通过在耕地土壤中固存碳来缓解气候变化。然而，由于生态差异、高昂的测量成本和不确定性，这一前景面临重大政策挑战。我们总结了关于农业土壤碳固存的最新科学文献，并描述了当前的政策环境。在此背景下，我们提出了一个用于政策分析的经济学框架。最后，我们强调：（a）需要改进测量，并制定对测量不准具有稳健性的政策；（b）提高农业生产率的重要性，以避免因农业用地扩张而导致未来的碳损失。

title: Using Vegetable Oils for Biofuel Accelerates Tropical Deforestation and Increases Carbon Emissions
abstract: Biofuels are promoted worldwide as a strategy to replace fossil fuels and cut greenhouse gas emissions. However, their climate benefits are uncertain because biofuel production can induce deforestation and other land use change that causes carbon emissions. Here we show that global demand for biomass-based diesel fuel between 2002 and 2018 drove the conversion of approximately 1.7 million hectares of forest to oil palm in Indonesia and Malaysia, which released more than one gigaton of CO2, giving biomass based diesel higher carbon emissions per megajoule than that of fossil diesel
abstract_zh: 生物燃料在全球范围内被推广，作为替代化石燃料、减少温室气体排放的一项战略。然而，其气候效益存在不确定性，因为生物燃料生产可能引发森林砍伐及其他导致碳排放的土地利用变化。本文表明，2002至2018年间全球对生物质柴油的需求，推动了印度尼西亚和马来西亚约170万公顷森林转变为油棕种植园，释放出超过十亿吨CO2，使生物质柴油每兆焦耳的碳排放高于化石柴油。

title: Do Time-of-Use Prices Deliver Energy Savings at the Right Time?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Time-of-use (TOU) electricity prices are increasingly being adopted to reduce consumption during the higher marginal cost afternoon hours. There is ample evidence that TOU rates reduce average consumption during the peak price hours of the day, but it is unknown how these energy savings are distributed across days. Using a unique dataset from households with smart thermostats, we find that adopting TOU rates causes large decreases in peak period AC usage, resulting in energy savings that are concentrated on the hottest, highest demand days when the benefits of conservation are the greatest.
abstract_zh: 分时电价（TOU）正被越来越多地采用，以减少在边际成本较高的下午时段的用电量。大量证据表明，分时电价可降低一天中高峰电价时段的平均用电量，但这些节能量在各日之间如何分布尚不清楚。利用一个来自安装智能温控器家庭的独特数据集，我们发现，采用分时电价会使高峰时段的空调用量大幅下降，且节能量集中在最炎热、用电需求最高的日子，而正是在这些日子里节约用电的收益最大。

title: Who is Responsible for ‘Responsible AI' ?: Navigating Challenges to Build Trust in AI Agriculture and Food System Technology Research
abstract: This article presents findings from interviews that were conducted with agriculture and food system researchers to understand their views about what it means to conduct ‘responsible’ or ‘trustworthy’ artificial intelligence (AI) research. Findings are organized into four themes: (1) data access and related ethical problems; (2) regulations and their impact on AI food system technology research; (3) barriers to the development and adoption of AI-based food system technologies; and (4) bridges of trust that researchers feel are important in overcoming the barriers they identified. All four themes reveal gray areas and contradictions that make it challenging for academic researchers to earn the trust of farmers and food producers. At the same time, this trust is foundational to research that would contribute to the development of high-quality AI technologies. Factors such as increasing regulations and worsening environmental conditions are stressing agricultural systems and are opening windows of opportunity for technological solutions. However, the dysfunctional process of technology development and adoption revealed in these interviews threatens to close these windows prematurely. Insights from these interviews can support governments and institutions in developing policies that will keep the windows open by helping to bridge divides between interests and supporting the development of technologies that deserve to be called “responsible” or “trustworthy” AI.
abstract_zh: 本文呈现了对农业与食品系统研究人员进行访谈的研究发现，旨在了解他们对开展“负责任”或“值得信赖”的人工智能（AI）研究意味着什么的看法。研究发现归纳为四个主题：（1）数据获取及相关的伦理问题；（2）监管及其对食品系统AI技术研究的影响；（3）基于AI的食品系统技术开发与采用的障碍；以及（4）研究人员认为在克服其所指出的障碍方面十分重要的信任桥梁。这四个主题都揭示了使学术研究人员难以赢得农民和食品生产者信任的灰色地带与矛盾。与此同时，这种信任是开展有助于发展高质量AI技术的研究的基础。日益增多的监管和不断恶化的环境条件正给农业系统带来压力，同时也为技术解决方案打开了机遇之窗。然而，访谈中揭示的技术开发与采用过程的失灵，可能使这些机遇之窗过早关闭。访谈所得的见解可为政府和机构制定政策提供支持，通过弥合各方利益之间的鸿沟，并支持开发真正配得上“负责任”或“值得信赖”之名的技术，使这些机遇之窗保持开放。

title: Safer Not to Know?: Shaping Liability Law and Policy to Incentivize Adoption of Predictive AI Technologies in the Food System
The effects of agricultural policy on supply and productivity: Evidence from differential changes in distortions
abstract: Incentives in agriculture are highly distorted. It has long been argued that these distortions were a key explanation for differences in supply and productivity across countries, but the empirical evidence is limited. We revisit this issue using data on policy distortions across 63 countries for the period 1961–2011. We estimate the effects of differential changes in agricultural distortions across countries on supply and productivity. We highlight concerns in our analysis and previous work about endogeneity that biases the estimated effect downward—countries that lose comparative advantage are likely to increase support for agriculture. We address these concerns by including country and region‐time fixed effects, along with a rich set of controls. Overall, we find evidence that enhanced incentives through policy changes can increase the rate of production growth, with about half of the increase due to productivity increases. This result is strongest in Sub‐Saharan Africa where anti‐agricultural policies on exports were reduced and in Europe where pro‐agricultural policies on imports were reduced, driven largely by external pressure. Endogeneity appears to be strongest in Asia where countries have followed the typical pattern of raising support for agriculture during industrialization due to a rising farm‐urban income gap.
abstract_zh: 农业中的激励机制存在严重扭曲。长期以来，人们一直认为这些扭曲是解释各国供给与生产率差异的关键原因，但相关实证证据有限。我们利用1961至2011年63个国家的政策扭曲数据重新审视这一问题。我们估计了各国农业扭曲的差异化变化对供给和生产率的影响。我们在本文分析及以往研究中指出了内生性问题：内生性会使估计效应向下偏误，因为失去比较优势的国家往往会增加对农业的支持。我们通过纳入国家及地区—时间固定效应，以及一组丰富的控制变量来处理这些问题。总体而言，我们发现，政策变化带来的激励增强能够提高产量增长率，其中约一半的增长来自生产率提高。这一结果在撒哈拉以南非洲地区最为明显，该地区减少了对农产品出口的反农业政策；在欧洲也很明显，该地区减少了对农产品进口的亲农业政策，且这一变化主要受外部压力驱动。内生性在亚洲似乎最强，亚洲国家在工业化进程中遵循了典型模式，即随着农民与城市居民之间收入差距扩大而提高对农业的支持。

title: Causality in Structural Vector Autoregressions: Science or Sorcery?
Environmental Outcomes of the US Renewable Fuel Standard
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Biofuels are included in many proposed strategies to reduce anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions and limit the magnitude of global warming. The US Renewable Fuel Standard is the world’s largest existing biofuel program, yet despite its prominence, there has been limited empirical assessment of the program’s environmental outcomes. Even without considering likely international land use effects, we find that the production of corn-based ethanol in the United States has failed to meet the policy’s own greenhouse gas emissions targets and negatively affected water quality, the area of land used for conservation, and other ecosystem processes. Our findings suggest that profound advances in technology and policy are still needed to achieve the intended environmental benefits of biofuel production and use.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料被纳入许多旨在减少人为温室气体排放并限制全球变暖幅度的方案。美国《可再生燃料标准》是世界上现存规模最大的生物燃料计划，但尽管其影响广泛，对该计划环境成效的实证评估仍然有限。即使不考虑可能的国际土地利用效应，我们发现美国以玉米为原料的乙醇生产，未能达到该政策自身设定的温室气体减排目标，并对水质、用于保护的土地面积以及其他生态系统过程产生了负面影响。我们的研究结果表明，要实现生物燃料生产与使用的预期环境效益，仍需要在技术和政策上取得重大进展。

title: Food vs. Fuel? Impacts of the North Dakota Oil Boom on Agricultural Prices
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Farmers and politicians in North Dakota and nearby states claim that dramatic increases in shipments of crude oil by rail in 2013–14 caused service delays and higher costs. We investigate these claims, accounting for other potential sources of rail congestion. We show that grain price spreads between the market hub and regional elevators expanded significantly when crude oil shipments increased. However, the incidence of those effects was borne mostly by buyers paying higher prices at the hub rather than farmers receiving lower prices. The effects differ by the type of grain being transported. Wheat markets were affected much more than corn and soybeans, most likely because shipping delays were more costly for wheat than corn and soybeans. When rail capacity is scarce, railroads use railcar auctions to price discriminate over the time sensitivity of a shipment.
abstract_zh: 北达科他州及邻近州的农民和政界人士声称，2013至2014年间原油铁路运输量的急剧增加导致了运输延误和成本上升。我们在考虑铁路拥堵其他潜在原因的前提下检验了这些说法。我们发现，当原油运输量增加时，市场枢纽与区域粮仓（elevator）之间的谷物价差显著扩大。然而，这种效应的负担主要由在枢纽以较高价格购粮的买方承担，而非由农民以较低价格出售获得的结果所体现。效应因运输的谷物品种而异：小麦市场受到的影响远大于玉米和大豆，很可能是因为运输延误对小麦的成本影响比对玉米和大豆更高。当铁路运力稀缺时，铁路公司通过车皮拍卖，根据货运对时间的敏感程度进行价格歧视。

title: Import Demand Elasticities Based on Quantity Data: Theory and Evidence
Residential Building Codes Do Save Energy: Evidence From Hourly Smart-Meter Data
abstract: In 1978, California adopted building codes designed to reduce the energy used for temperature control. Using a rich data set of hourly electricity consumption for 158,112 houses in Sacramento, we estimate that the average house built just after 1978 uses 8% to 13% less electricity for cooling than a similar house built just before 1978. Comparing the estimated savings to the policy's projected cost, our results suggest the policy passes a cost-benefit test. In settings where market failures prevent energy costs from being completely passed through to home prices, building codes can serve as a cost- effective tool for improving energy efficiency.
abstract_zh: 1978年，加利福尼亚州通过了旨在降低温度控制能耗的建筑法规。利用萨克拉门托158,112户住宅的小时级用电量丰富数据，我们估计，1978年后刚建成的住宅，其空调用电量比1978年前建成的类似住宅低8%至13%。将估计的节能量与该政策的预计成本相比较，我们的结果表明，该政策通过了成本效益检验。在市场失灵导致能源成本无法完全传导至房价的情境下，建筑法规可以成为提高能源效率的一种具有成本效益的工具。

title: Productivity Spillovers from Pollution Reduction: Reducing Coal use Increases Crop Yields
abstract: Air pollution reduces crop yields by slowing down photosynthesis. We estimate the increase in US corn and soybean yields attributed to the recent dramatic reductions in emissions of nitrogen oxides (NOx) from electric power plants. In response to the observed changes in power plant NOx emissions over the eight‐year period from 2003–05 to 2011–13, we estimate that average corn yields improved by 2.46% and soybean yields by 1.62%. These improvements imply an increase in total surplus of $1.60 billion annually across the two crops. The estimated yield improvements vary substantially across states depending on the change in NOx emissions. For corn, they range from 0.32% to 6.87% and for soybeans, they range from 0.21% to 4.30%. The demand for the two crops is quite inelastic, which means that prices decrease by more than production increases in response to this positive productivity shock and the implied rightward shift of the crop supply curve. Due to the low elasticities of supply and demand for U.S. corn and soybeans, we conclude from a welfare analysis that these changes made consumers better off and farmers worse off.
abstract_zh: 空气污染通过减缓光合作用降低作物产量。我们估算了美国近期因燃煤电厂氮氧化物（NOx）排放大幅减少而带来的玉米和大豆增产。根据2003–05年至2011–13年八年间电厂NOx排放的实际变化，我们估计玉米平均单产提高了2.46%，大豆平均单产提高了1.62%。这些增产意味着两种作物每年的社会总剩余合计增加16亿美元。估计的单产改善在各州之间差异很大，取决于NOx排放的变化幅度。玉米的单产改善幅度在0.32%至6.87%之间，大豆在0.21%至4.30%之间。两种作物的需求都缺乏弹性，这意味着，在这一正向生产率冲击下，价格的下降幅度超过产量的增幅，作物供给曲线随之向右移动。由于美国玉米和大豆的供给与需求弹性较低，我们从福利分析中得出结论：这些变化使消费者受益，而农民受损。

title: Returns to Investing in Commodity Futures: Separating the Wheat from the Chaff
Do Speculators Drive Commodity Prices Away from Supply and Demand Fundamentals?
Option-Implied Equity Premium Predictions via Entropic Tilting
A Century of US Farm Productivity Growth: A Surge then a Slowdown
abstract: U.S. farm productivity growth has direct consequences for sustainably feeding the world's still rapidly growing population, as well as U.S. competitiveness in international markets. Using a newly expanded compilation of multifactor productivity (MFP) estimates and associated partial‐factor productivity (PFP) measures, we examine changes in the pattern of U.S. agricultural productivity growth over the past century and more. Considering the evidence as a whole, we detect sizable and significant slowdowns in the rate of productivity growth in recent decades. U.S. multifactor productivity grew at an annual average rate of just 1.16% per year during 1990–2007 compared with 1.42% per year for the period 1910–2007. U.S. yields of major crops grew at an annual average rate of 1.17% per year for 1990–2009 compared with 1.81% per year for 1936–1990. More subtly, but with potentially profound implications, the relatively high rates of MFP growth during the third quarter of the century are an historical aberration relative to the long‐run trend.
abstract_zh: 美国农业生产率增长对于可持续地养活仍在快速增长的世界人口，以及美国在国际市场上的竞争力，都具有直接影响。利用新近扩充的多要素生产率（MFP）估计值及相关的偏要素生产率（PFP）指标，我们考察了过去一个世纪乃至更长时期内美国农业生产率增长模式的变化。综合全部证据来看，我们发现近几十年生产率增长速度出现了显著且具有统计意义的放缓。1990–2007年间，美国多要素生产率的年均增长率仅为每年1.16%，而1910–2007年期间为每年1.42%。1990–2009年间，美国主要作物单产的年均增长率为每年1.17%，而1936–1990年间为每年1.81%。更为微妙、但可能具有深远影响的是，本世纪中期（第三个四分之一世纪）相对较高的多要素生产率增长速度，相对于长期趋势而言，是一种历史上的反常现象。

title: Commodity Price Comovement and Financial Speculation: The Case of Cotton
Designing Climate Policy: Lessons from the Renewable Fuel Standard and the Blend Wall
abstract: Many policies mandate renewable energy production to combat global climate change. These policies often differ significantly from first‐best policy prescriptions. Among the largest renewable energy mandates enacted to date is the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), which mandates biofuel consumption far beyond what is feasible with current technology and infrastructure. We critically review the methods used by the Environmental Protection Agency to project near‐ and long‐term compliance costs under the RFS, and draw lessons from the RFS experience to date that would improve the program's efficiency. The lessons are meant to inform both future RFS rulemaking and the design of future climate policies. We draw two lessons specific to the RFS. First, incorporate uncertainty into rulemaking; second, implement multi‐year rules. Multi‐year rulemaking allows for longer periods between major regulatory decisions and sends greater certainty to markets. We also provide two more general recommendations: tie waiver authority to compliance costs or include cost containment provisions, and fund research and development of new technologies directly rather than mandating them. Future technological advancement is uncertain, and mandating new technologies has proven to be largely ineffective to date, particularly in fuel markets.
abstract_zh: 许多政策要求强制生产可再生能源以应对全球气候变化。这些政策往往与最优政策处方存在显著差异。迄今为止颁布的最大规模可再生能源强制性要求之一是《可再生燃料标准》（RFS），该标准要求的生物燃料消费量远超现有技术和基础设施所能达到的水平。我们批判性地回顾了美国环境保护署（EPA）在RFS下预测近期与长期合规成本所采用的方法，并从迄今为止的RFS经验中总结教训，以提高该计划的效率。这些教训既旨在为未来的RFS规则制定提供参考，也旨在为未来气候政策的设计提供借鉴。我们得出两条针对RFS的具体教训：第一，在规则制定中纳入不确定性；第二，实施多年期规则。多年期规则制定可以拉长重大监管决策之间的间隔，并向市场提供更大的确定性。我们还提出两条更一般性的建议：将豁免权限与合规成本挂钩或纳入成本控制条款，以及直接资助新技术的研发，而非强制使用这些技术。未来的技术进步具有不确定性，迄今为止，强制使用新技术的做法已被证明基本无效，在燃料市场中尤其如此。

title: Effects of Crop Insurance Premium Subsidies on Crop Acreage
abstract: Crop insurance premium subsidies affect patterns of crop acreage for two reasons. First, holding insurance coverage constant, premium subsidies directly increase expected profit, which encourages more acreage of insured crops (direct profit effect). Second, premium subsidies encourage farms to increase crop insurance coverage. With more insurance coverage, farms obtain more subsidies, and farm revenue becomes less variable as indemnities offset revenue shortfalls, so acreage of insured crops likely increases (indirect coverage effect). By exploiting exogenous policy changes and using approximately 180,000 county‐crop‐year observations, we estimate the sum of these two effects of premium subsidies on the pattern of U.S. acreage across seven major field crops. We estimate that a 10% increase in the premium subsidy causes a 0.43% increase in the acreage of a crop in a county holding the premium subsidy of its competing crop constant. Taking into account the small share of premium subsidies in expected crop revenue, this subsidy impact is analogous to an own‐subsidy acreage elasticity of 1.24, which exceeds own‐price acreage elasticity estimates in the literature. One explanation for the larger acreage response to premium subsidies is that insurance causes an indirect coverage effect in addition to a direct profit effect.
abstract_zh: 农作物保险保费补贴通过两种途径影响作物种植面积结构。第一，在保险覆盖水平不变的情况下，保费补贴直接提高预期利润，从而鼓励扩大投保作物的种植面积（直接利润效应）。第二，保费补贴鼓励农场提高农作物保险的覆盖水平。保险覆盖越高，农场获得的补贴越多；同时，由于赔付可以弥补收入不足，农场收入的波动性降低，因此投保作物的种植面积很可能增加（间接覆盖效应）。通过利用外生政策变化，并使用约18万个县—作物—年份观测值，我们估计了这两种效应之和对美国七种主要大田作物种植面积结构的影响。我们估计，在保持竞争作物的保费补贴不变的情况下，保费补贴每提高10%，某县某作物的种植面积增加0.43%。考虑到保费补贴在预期作物收入中所占比例较小，这一补贴影响相当于自身补贴的种植面积弹性为1.24，超过了文献中关于自身价格种植面积弹性的估计值。对保费补贴产生更大种植面积反应的一种解释是，保险除了带来直接利润效应，还引发了间接覆盖效应。

title: Policy Shocks and Market-Based Regulations: Evidence from the Renewable Fuel Standard
abstract: The Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS2) mandates large increases in U.S. biofuel consumption and is implemented using a market for tradable compliance credits, known as RINs. In early 2013, RIN prices soared, causing the regulator to propose reducing future mandates. We develop a dynamic model of RFS2 compliance to demonstrate how changes in expectations about future policy affect current compliance costs, and we use a market effciency test to demonstrate that RIN markets have behaved in accordance with our model. We then estimate empirically the effect of three "policy shocks" that reduced the expected mandates in 2013. The largest of these shocks decreased the total cost of compliance by nearly $8 billion. The burden of the mandate reductions fell primarily on advanced biofuel firms and on commodity markets of the marginal compliance biofuel. We argue that the policy shocks reduced the incentive to invest in the technologies required to meet the future objectives of the RFS2. JEL Codes: Q42, Q50, H23
abstract_zh: 《可再生燃料标准》（RFS2）要求美国生物燃料消费量大幅增长，并通过一个可交易合规额度（称为RIN）的市场来实施。2013年初，RIN价格飙升，促使监管机构提议降低未来的强制配额。我们构建了一个RFS2合规的动态模型，以说明对未来政策预期的变化如何影响当前的合规成本；并使用市场效率检验来证明RIN市场的行为与我们的模型相符。随后，我们以实证方法估计了2013年三次降低预期强制配额的“政策冲击”的效应。其中最大的一次冲击使合规总成本减少了近80亿美元。配额降低的负担主要落在先进生物燃料企业以及边际合规生物燃料的商品市场上。我们认为，这些政策冲击削弱了企业投资于实现RFS2未来目标所需技术的激励。JEL分类号：Q42, Q50, H23

title: The Incentive to Overinvest in Energy Efficiency: Evidence from Hourly Smart-Meter Data
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Many households pay a marginal price for electricity that exceeds the marginal social cost of supplying that electricity. We show evidence that such pricing schemes can create an incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency. Using hourly smart-meter data for households facing time-invariant increasing block prices, we estimate how air conditioner upgrades affect electricity use. We find that the average participating household reduces consumption by 5%, which provides private savings in the form of lower electricity bills and social cost savings by decreasing generation and pollution costs. The private savings exceed the social savings by an average of 140%, so the average household is faced with an incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency. This incentive to overinvest in energy efficiency would be cut in half if consumers faced any one of three alternative pricing plans with lower marginal price but the same average price.
abstract_zh: 许多家庭支付的电力边际价格超过了供电的边际社会成本。我们提供证据表明，此类定价方案可能激励过度投资于能源效率。利用面对时间不变的递增阶梯电价的家庭小时级智能电表数据，我们估计了空调升级对用电量的影响。我们发现，参与升级的家庭平均减少了5%的用电量，这既带来了电费降低形式的私人节省，也通过减少发电和污染成本带来了社会成本节约。私人节省平均比社会节省高出140%，因此，平均而言，家庭面临过度投资于能源效率的激励。如果消费者面对的是边际价格较低但平均价格相同的三种替代定价方案中的任意一种，这种过度投资的激励将减半。

Ethanol Production and Gasoline Prices: A Spurious Correlation
abstract: Ethanol made from corn comprises 10% of U.S. gasoline, up from 3% in 2003. This dramatic increase was spurred by recent policy initiatives such as the Renewable Fuel Standard and state-level blend mandates and supported by direct subsidies such as the Volumetric Ethanol Excise Tax Credit. Some proponents of ethanol have argued that ethanol production greatly lowers gasoline prices, with one industry group claiming it reduced gasoline prices by 89 cents in 2010 and $1.09 in 2011. The 2010 figure has been cited in numerous speeches by Secretary of Agriculture Thomas Vilsack. We show that these estimates were generated by implausible economic assumptions and spurious statistical correlations. To support this last point, we use the same statistical models and find that ethanol production “decreases” natural gas prices, but “increases” unemployment in both the U.S. and Europe. We even show that ethanol production “increases” the ages of our children. Overall, we see no compelling reason to believe that the effect of ethanol use on gasoline prices has been more than $0.10 per gallon.
abstract_zh: 以玉米为原料生产的乙醇占美国汽油的10%，而2003年这一比例仅为3%。这一急剧增长由《可再生燃料标准》及州级掺混强制要求等近期政策推动，并得到乙醇体积消费税抵免等直接补贴的支持。一些乙醇支持者认为，乙醇生产大幅降低了汽油价格，某行业团体声称其在2010年使汽油价格下降了89美分，2011年下降了1.09美元。2010年的这一数字在农业部长汤姆·维尔萨克（Thomas Vilsack）的多次讲话中被引用。我们证明，这些估计是由不合理的经济假设和虚假的统计相关性得出的。为支持这一最后论点，我们使用相同的统计模型发现，乙醇生产“降低”了天然气价格，却“提高”了美国和欧洲的失业率。我们甚至证明，乙醇生产“增加”了我们子女的年龄。总体而言，我们认为没有令人信服的理由相信乙醇使用对汽油价格的影响超过了每加仑0.10美元。

title: Crop Supply Dynamics and the Illusion of Partial Adjustment
abstract: We use field‐level data to estimate the response of corn and soybean acreage to price shocks. Our sample contains more than 8 million observations derived from satellite imagery and includes every cultivated field in Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana. We estimate that aggregate crop acreage responds more to price shocks in the short run than in the long run, and we show theoretically how the benefits of crop rotation generate this response pattern. In essence, farmers who change crops due to a price shock have an incentive to switch back to the previous crop to capture the benefits of crop rotation. Our result contradicts the long‐held belief that agricultural supply responds gradually to price shocks through partial adjustment. We would not have obtained this result had we used county‐level panel data. Standard econometric methods applied to county‐level data produce estimates consistent with partial adjustment. We show that this apparent partial adjustment is illusory, and we demonstrate how it arises from the fact that fields in the same county are more similar to each other than to fields in other counties. This result underscores the importance of using models with appropriate micro‐foundations and cautions against inferring micro‐level rigidities from inertia in aggregate panel data. Our preferred estimate of the own‐price long‐run elasticity of corn acreage is 0.29, and the cross‐price elasticity is −0.22. The corresponding elasticities for soybean acreage are 0.26 and −0.33. Our estimated short‐run elasticities are 37% larger than their long‐run counterparts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用田块层面的数据，估计玉米和大豆种植面积对价格冲击的反应。样本包含超过800万个观测值，源自卫星影像，涵盖爱荷华州、伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的每一块耕种田地。我们估计，农作物总种植面积在短期内对价格冲击的反应大于长期，并从理论上说明了轮作收益如何产生这一反应模式。实质上，因价格冲击而改种作物的农民有动机转回原先的作物，以获取轮作的好处。我们的结果与长期流行的“农业供给通过部分调整对价格冲击逐步做出反应”的观点相矛盾。如果我们使用县级面板数据，将得不到这一结果。应用于县级数据的标准计量方法会得出与部分调整相一致的估计结果。我们表明，这种表面上的部分调整是虚幻的，并说明其产生的原因在于：同一县内的田块彼此之间的相似性，高于与其他县田块之间的相似性。这一结果突显了使用具有恰当微观基础的模型的重要性，并警示不要从总量面板数据的惯性中推断微观层面的刚性。我们偏好的玉米种植面积自身价格长期弹性估计值为0.29，交叉价格弹性为−0.22。大豆种植面积的对应弹性分别为0.26和−0.33。我们估计的短期弹性比其长期对应值大37%。

title: Deconstructing Wheat Price Spikes: A Model of Supply and Demand, Financial Speculation, and Commodity Price Comovement
Hedging and Speculative Trading in Agricultural Futures Markets
abstract: Regulators and industry participants have expressed concern that excessive speculation harms agricultural futures markets. Such harm may arise if speculators cause prices to systematically differ from the price sequence that would arise in markets populated by equally informed traders with rational expectations (RE). We show theoretically that, when traders exhibit differences of opinion (DO) about the expected value of the commodity, futures prices may diverge from the RE equilibrium. Moreover, we develop a testable prediction, namely that positions held by different trader groups are correlated with prices in a DO equilibrium but not correlated in a RE equilibrium. We find strong empirical support for the DO‐type environment; changes in positions held by managed money traders are positively correlated with prices, and changes in positions held by producers are negatively correlated. In the context of our DO model, this finding implies that prices change by more on average than producers think they should and by less than managed money thinks they should. However, the evidence suggests that neither group is systematically more prescient than the other.
abstract_zh: 监管机构和行业参与者担心，过度投机会损害农产品期货市场。如果投机者使价格系统性地偏离由信息相同、具有理性预期（RE）的交易者所形成的价格序列，这种损害就可能产生。我们从理论上表明，当交易者对商品的预期价值存在意见分歧（DO）时，期货价格可能偏离理性预期均衡。此外，我们提出了一个可检验的预测：在意见分歧均衡中，不同交易者群体持有的头寸与价格相关，而在理性预期均衡中则不相关。我们发现了意见分歧型环境的有力实证支持：管理基金交易者持仓的变化与价格正相关，而生产者持仓的变化与价格负相关。在我们的意见分歧模型中，这一发现意味着，价格的平均变动幅度大于生产者认为应有的幅度，却小于管理基金认为应有的幅度。然而，证据表明，两个群体中没有哪一方系统性地比另一方更具远见。

title: Weather Shocks and Inter-Hemispheric Supply Responses: Implications for Climate Change Effects on Global Food Markets
abstract: Climate models predict more weather extremes in the coming decades. Weather shocks can directly reduce crop production, but their effect on food markets is partly buffered by storage and supply responses that can be complex and nuanced. We explore how inter-hemispheric trade and supply responses can moderate the effects of weather shocks on global food supply by enabling potential intra-annual arbitrage. Our estimates of this effect in the case of wheat and soybeans suggest that it may be considerable: 25–50% of crop production lost to a shock in the Southern Hemisphere is offset six months later by increased production in the North. These results have implications for the potential effects of climate change on global food markets, for how we model these interactions and, possibly, for the design of trade and production-related policies that aim to leverage this inter-hemispheric buffer more effectively.
abstract_zh: 气候模型预测，未来几十年极端天气将增多。天气冲击可直接减少作物产量，但其对粮食市场的影响在一定程度上会被库存及供给反应所缓冲，而这些反应可能十分复杂且细微。我们探讨了跨半球贸易与供给反应如何通过实现潜在的年内套利，来缓和天气冲击对全球粮食供应的影响。针对小麦和大豆，我们对这一效应的估计表明其可能相当显著：南半球遭受冲击所损失的作物产量中，有25%–50%会在六个月后因北半球产量增加而被抵消。这些结果对于气候变化对全球粮食市场的潜在影响、对我们如何对这些相互作用进行建模，以及或许对旨在更有效利用这一跨半球缓冲机制的贸易与生产相关政策设计，都具有启示意义。

title: Non-Convergence in Domestic Commodity Futures Markets: Causes, Consequences, and Remedies
The Nonlinear Multidimensional Relationship Between Stock Returns and the Macroeconomy
Does the Red Flag Rule Induce Risk Taking in Sprint Finishes? Moral Hazard Crashes in Cycling's Grand Tours
Identifying Informed Traders in Futures Markets
Immigration and the US Farm Labour Supply
abstract: This paper uses unique data from rural Mexico to examine the supply of immigrant hired labour to US farms. Econometric evidence indicates that immigration policy reforms had unintended consequences for farm labour supply. The long-term trend in migration from rural Mexico to US farms is decreasing, and in recent years, US farms have drawn more labour from remote and less developed areas of rural Mexico. Other high income countries, as well as some developing nations, mirror the US in reliance on foreign agricultural workers. Our analysis questions the sustainability of an agricultural system that depends on foreign sources of labour, and highlights the importance of labour productivity-enhancing technological change.
abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥农村的独特数据，考察移民雇佣劳动力向美国农场的供给。计量证据表明，移民政策改革对农业劳动力供给产生了非预期的后果。墨西哥农村向美国农场迁移的长期趋势正在下降，近年来，美国农场越来越多地从墨西哥农村中较为偏远、较不发达的地区吸纳劳动力。其他高收入国家以及部分发展中国家，与美国一样依赖外国农业工人。我们的分析对依赖外国劳动力来源的农业体系的可持续性提出了质疑，并凸显了提高劳动生产率的技术变革的重要性。

title: Markov Breaks in Regression Models
Using USDA Forecasts to Estimate the Price Flexibility of Demand for Agricultural Commodities
abstract: We estimate the general equilibrium price flexibility of demand for corn and soybeans using monthly changes in expected supply published by the USDA. Our estimates reflect the demand response to a one‐year supply shock and thus correspond to the inverse demand elasticity. We derive the conditions under which our estimates are consistent, and we show how demand flexibility varies by season, inventory, time horizon, and demand composition. At average inventory and without accounting for corn‐ethanol use, we obtain price flexibility estimates of −1.35 and −1.03 for corn and soybeans, respectively. Current corn‐ethanol production levels are associated with much larger absolute flexibilities for both commodities.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国农业部（USDA）公布的预期供给月度变化，估计玉米和大豆需求的一般均衡价格弹性。我们的估计反映了需求对一年期供给冲击的反应，因此对应于逆需求弹性。我们推导了估计结果保持一致的条件，并说明需求弹性如何随季节、库存、时间跨度及需求构成而变化。在平均库存水平下，且不计入玉米乙醇用途时，我们得到玉米和大豆的价格弹性估计值分别为−1.35和−1.03。当前的玉米乙醇生产水平与两种商品大得多的绝对弹性相关。

title: Commodity Booms and Busts
Volatility Dynamics and Seasonality in Energy Prices: Implications for Crack-Spread Price Risk
abstract: We examine the volatility dynamics of three major petroleum commodities traded on the NYMEX: crude oil, unleaded gasoline, and heating oil. Using the partially overlapping time-series (POTS) framework of Smith (2005), we model jointly all futures contracts with delivery dates up to a year into the future and extract information from these prices about the persistence of market shocks. The model depicts highly nonlinear volatility dynamics that are consistent with the observed seasonality in demand and storage of the three commodities. Specifically, volatility of the three commodity prices exhibits time-to-delivery effects and substantial seasonality, yet their patterns vary systematically by contract delivery month. The conditional variance and correlation across the three commodities also vary over time. High price volatility of near-delivery contracts and their low correlation with concurrently traded distant contracts imply high short-horizon price risk for an unhedged position in the calendar or crack spread. Price risk at the one-year horizon is much lower than short-horizon risk in all seasons and for all positions, but it is still substantial in magnitude for crack-spread positions. Crack-spread hedgers ignore nearby high-season price risk at their peril, but they would also be remiss to ignore the long horizon.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了纽约商品交易所（NYMEX）交易的三种主要石油商品的波动动态：原油、无铅汽油和取暖油。利用Smith（2005）的部分重叠时间序列（POTS）框架，我们对交割日期长达一年的所有期货合约进行联合建模，并从这些价格中提取关于市场冲击持续性的信息。该模型刻画了高度非线性的波动动态，这与三种商品在需求和库存方面观察到的季节性相一致。具体而言，三种商品价格的波动表现出交割时间效应和显著的季节性，但其模式因合约交割月份不同而系统性地变化。三种商品之间的条件方差和相关性也随时间变化。近月合约的高价格波动，以及其与同期交易的远月合约之间的低相关性，意味着对于未对冲的日历价差或裂解价差（crack spread）头寸，其短期价格风险很高。一年期的价格风险在所有季节和所有头寸中都远低于短期风险，但对于裂解价差头寸而言，其规模仍然可观。裂解价差的套期保值者若忽视近期高需求季节的价格风险，将自担风险；而忽视长期视角同样属于失职。

title: Volatility Dynamics of NYMEX Natural Gas Futures Prices
abstract: We examine the volatility dynamics of NYMEX natural gas futures prices via the partially overlapping time‐series model of Smith (2005. Journal of Applied Econometrics, 20, 405–422). We show that volatility exhibits two important features: (1) volatility is greater in the winter than in the summer, and (2) the persistence of price shocks and, hence, the correlations among concurrently traded contracts, displays substantial seasonal and cross‐sectional variation in a way consistent with the theory of storage. We demonstrate that, by ignoring the seasonality in the volatility dynamics of natural gas futures prices, previous studies have suggested sub‐optimal hedging strategies. © 2008 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Jrl Fut Mark 28:438–463, 2008
abstract_zh: 我们通过Smith（2005，《应用计量经济学杂志》，第20卷，第405–422页）的部分重叠时间序列模型，考察了纽约商品交易所天然气期货价格的波动动态。我们表明，波动呈现两个重要特征：（1）冬季的波动大于夏季；（2）价格冲击的持续性，以及由此决定的同期交易合约之间的相关性，表现出显著的季节性和截面差异，且这一模式与储存理论相一致。我们证明，以往研究忽视了天然气期货价格波动动态中的季节性，因而提出了次优的套期保值策略。© 2008 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Jrl Fut Mark 28:438–463, 2008

title: Effects of Milk Marketing Order Regulation on the Share of Fluid-Grade Milk in the United States
Efficiency of the California Electricity Reserves Market
abstract: We test the efficiency of the California electricity reserves market by examining systematic differences between its day‐ and hour‐ahead prices. We uncover significant day‐ahead premia, which we attribute to market design characteristics. On the demand side, the market design established a principal–agent relationship between the markets' buyers (principal) and their supervisory authority (agent). The agent had very limited incentives to shift reserve purchases to the lower priced hour‐ahead markets. On the supply side, the market design raised substantial entry barriers by precluding purely speculative trading and by introducing a complicated code of conduct that induced uncertainty about which actions were subject to regulatory scrutiny. We use a high‐dimensional vector moving average model to estimate the premia and conduct correct inferences. To obtain exact maximum likelihood estimates of the model, we develop a new EM algorithm that seamlessly incorporates missing data and applies directly to general moving average time series models. Our algorithm uses only analytical expressions: the Kalman filter and a fixed interval smoother in the E step and least squares‐type regressions in the M step. abstract_zh: 我们通过考察加州电力备用容量市场日前价格与时前价格之间的系统性差异，检验其效率。我们发现存在显著的日前溢价，并将其归因于市场设计特征。在需求侧，市场设计在市场买方（委托人）与其监管机构（代理人）之间建立了委托—代理关系。代理人几乎没有激励将备用容量采购转向价格较低的时前市场。在供给侧，市场设计通过禁止纯投机性交易，并引入一套复杂的行为准则（使哪些行为会受到监管审查变得不确定），从而设置了较高的进入壁垒。我们使用高维向量移动平均模型来估计溢价并进行正确的统计推断。为获得该模型的精确极大似然估计，我们开发了一种新的EM算法，该算法能够无缝纳入缺失数据，并可直接适用于一般的移动平均时间序列模型。我们的算法仅使用解析表达式：E步采用卡尔曼滤波和固定区间平滑器，M步采用最小二乘型回归。版权所有 © 2007 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

title: Impacts of Policy Reforms on the Supply of Mexican Labor to US Farms: New Evidence from Mexico
abstract: The availability of immigrant farm-workers from Mexico is a critical factor affecting the fresh fruit and vegetable sector in the United States. This paper uses a retrospective panel data set from rural Mexico to examine the impact of the North American Free Trade Agreement and the Immigration Reform and Control Act on the supply of migrant labor to the United States. We find that, in contrast to policy expectations, both policies were associated with an increase in migration to U.S. farm jobs from rural Mexico. Impacts of Policy Reforms on the Supply of Mexican Labor to U.S. Farms: New Evidence from Mexico

Computer and Internet use by Great Plains Farmers
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: We use data from a 2001 survey of Great Plains farmers to explore the adoption, usage patterns, and perceived benefits of computers and the Internet. Our adoption results suggest that exposure to the technology through college, outside employment, friends, and family is ultimately more influential than farmer age and farm size. Notably, about half of those who use the Internet for farm-related business report zero economic benefits from it. Whether a farmer perceives that the Internet generates economic benefits depends primarily on how long the farmer has used the Internet for farm business and for what purposes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年对美国大平原地区农民的调查数据，考察计算机和互联网的采用情况、使用模式以及农民所感知的收益。我们的采用结果表明，通过大学、外部就业、朋友和家人接触该技术，最终比农民年龄和农场规模的影响更大。值得注意的是，约一半将互联网用于农场相关业务的农民报告称，互联网没有带来任何经济效益。农民是否认为互联网产生了经济效益，主要取决于其将互联网用于农场业务的时间长短以及具体用途。
